mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A collapse in industrial production, as measured by a 3% m-o-m decline in the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines > 3% m-o-m but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate, defined as a 50 basis point increase over the past 3 months, signals a hawkish Fed pivot that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises > 50bps in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in consumer sentiment, as measured by a 5% m-o-m decline in the RSAFS index, signals a collapse in consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines > 5% m-o-m but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating job market, as measured by a 100k increase in PAYEMS over the past 3 months, signals a strengthening economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS increases by > 100k over 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in inflation, as measured by a 1% m-o-m increase in CPI, combined with a hawkish Fed response (FEDFUNDS > 4%), signals a stagflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 1% m-o-m AND FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market collapse, as measured by a 10% y-o-y decline in HOUST, combined with a weakening job market (UNRATE > 6%), signals a recessionary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST declines > 10% y-o-y AND UNRATE > 6% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.
